summary.intent: Investigate and fix a failing E2E test in CI related to breadcrumb navigation in writable shared folders.
summary.outcome: The root cause was identified (breadcrumb not updating after navigating into a nested subfolder within a writable share), but no fix was committed — the session ended at the investigation/diagnosis phase.

repo: Breadcrumb state for shared folder navigation lives in `useSharedNavigation.ts` and is managed via `setBreadcrumbs`.
The shared file browser has its own page object at `tests/web-e2e/page-objects/file-browser/shared-file-browser.page.ts` with a `doubleClickFolderItem` method for folder navigation.
E2E tests for writable shares are in `tests/web-e2e/tests/writable-shares.spec.ts`; the failing assertion was at line 651 (test 8.3).
The shared file browser component is `apps/web/src/components/file-browser/SharedFileBrowser.tsx`, which consumes `useSharedNavigation`.

code.finding: Failing assertion: breadcrumb expected to include deep subfolder name after Bob navigates into a nested subfolder, but still shows only `~/shared/write-share-...`.
setBreadcrumbs is the likely culprit — something resets breadcrumbs after subfolder navigation, possibly the poll/refresh, upload handler, createFolder handler, or navigateToShare logic.

workflow: Used `gh` CLI to fetch CI run logs and identify the failing test before diving into source code.
Grep for `setBreadcrumbs` across the codebase was the key step to narrow down where breadcrumb state could be incorrectly reset.
Checked recent git history of the hook file to correlate the regression with the writable shares PR.

friction: The hook file (`useSharedNavigation.ts`) was read many times in segments, suggesting it is large and the relevant logic was spread across the file.

Multiple grep passes were needed (onDoubleClick, poll/refresh/upload, handleRevocation, navigateToShare) before zeroing in on the reset path — the breadcrumb reset trigger was not immediately obvious.
No fix was reached within the session despite extensive investigation.
open_items: The actual bug fix in `useSharedNavigation.ts` (or `SharedFileBrowser.tsx`) to prevent breadcrumbs from being reset after subfolder navigation in writable shares is still unimplemented.

It was not confirmed which specific code path (poll/refresh, createFolder, upload handler, or navigateToShare) is responsible for resetting breadcrumbs — needs final root-cause confirmation before fixing.
Local infra spin-up and full E2E suite run (mentioned in the user's original request as a fallback) was never needed/executed — worth keeping in mind if the fix introduces regressions elsewhere.
